item.title: How to choose a Korean sunscreen
item.description: How to choose a Korean sunscreen. PA++++ is the top UVA grade. Mineral (무기자차) suits sensitive skin. Chemical (유기자차) feels lighter. Look for the No white cast tag. Korea's #1 right now: Round Lab Birch Juice Moisturizing Sunscreen.

item.title: How to choose a Korean toner
item.description: How to choose a Korean toner. Korean toner hydrates, it is not an astringent. Toner pads with PHA: quick gentle exfoliation. Dry skin: glycerin, panthenol, hyaluronic acid. Sensitive skin: centella or mugwort. Korea's #1 right now: TONYMOLY Ceramide Mochi Toner.

item.title: Korean serum, essence or ampoule?
item.description: Korean serum, essence or ampoule?. The names have no legal difference. Pick by active ingredient, not the word. Niacinamide: tone and oil control. Centella, heartleaf: soothing. Korea's #1 right now: Abib Hyaluronic Boom Serum Water Drop.

item.title: How to choose a Korean moisturizer
item.description: How to choose a Korean moisturizer. Gel cream: oily skin, hot weather. Ceramide barrier cream: dry skin, winter. Centella or panthenol: redness. Seal in toner and serum with it. Korea's #1 right now: Aestura Atobarrier 365 Cream.

item.title: Korean double cleansing in 2 steps
item.description: Korean double cleansing in 2 steps. 1. Oil or balm on dry skin, then rinse. 2. Foam or gel cleanser. Morning: one gentle cleanser is enough. Tight after washing? Try a low-pH foam. Korea's #1 right now: beplain Mung Bean pH-Balanced Cleansing Foam.
